verdict.rationale: Base44 docs show built-in scaffolded auth: ready-made login/register/forgot-password pages supporting email plus social providers like Google, customizable and branded (docs-11, docs-30, docs-41, docs-25). However, an independent security report found the registration/email-verification endpoints were exploitable via just the app_id, letting attackers register themselves as editor/collaborator on any app — a concrete hands-on failure of the scaffolded auth system (though fixed within 24h). missing for 10: independent confirmation the fix is robust, and no mention of OAuth/social provider setup mechanics beyond marketing copy.
